data.one_liner: Dart timekeeping facilities to get system uptime and elapsed time.
data.what_it_does: Provides timekeeping facilities powered by dart:ffi to easily retrieve system uptime and elapsed realtime. Supports Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, with web falling back to DateTime.now().
use_when: You need to measure system uptime excluding deep sleep time.
You need to measure elapsed realtime including time spent in sleep.
You need high-resolution timing on supported desktop and mobile platforms.
avoid_when: You only need standard wall-clock time provided by core Dart libraries.
You are targeting web platforms where native system clocks are not accessible and fall back to standard time.
strengths: Easy to get uptime and elapsed time.
Cross-platform support including mobile and desktop via FFI.
Pure Dart package requiring no Flutter plugin dependencies.
weaknesses: Web platform is limited to a fallback of DateTime.now().
